holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Bagchi resigned as ICICI Life MD & CEO effective October 13, 2026, with Sidharatha Mishra appointed as his successor from October 14, 2026.
The bank received a GST show cause notice on September 30, 2026, demanding ₹229.14 crore plus applicable interest and penalties.
The Securities Appellate Tribunal set aside an earlier order granting portal access in the Chanda Kochhar matter.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth in Q2 for large banks including ICICI Bank.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the portfolio's largest holding at 9.78% weight; its -3.30% 3-month return heavily shapes returns in the fund's 39.6% Financials sleeve.

watch.text: Upcoming Q2 FY27 earnings report scheduled alongside major banking peers.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: M&M reported September 2026 vehicle production of 121,722 units and sales of 113,705 units.
Embraer agreed to acquire a 51% stake in Novavayu Aerospace from M&M for about ₹5,10,000 by December 1, 2026.
The company completed non-deal investor roadshows in Boston and New York in October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 5.94% weight, M&M is the fund's largest non-financial bet and its third-largest 3-month detractor (-0.633% contribution, -10.65% return).

watch.text: CCI approval decision regarding Lightrock Group's proposed stake acquisition in Mahindra Last Mile Mobility.
Closing of the 51% Novavayu Aerospace stake sale to Embraer by December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO for a three-year term starting January 1, 2027.
Provisional Q2 updates showed net advances of ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits of ₹6,51,491 crore.
Subsidiaries KMIL and KAAML approved an amalgamation with an exchange ratio of 7 KAAML shares for every 6 KMIL shares.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth across major private lenders including Kotak Mahindra Bank.

holdings.why_it_matters: Kotak Bank is the fund's top positive contributor (+0.876% contribution, +16.79% return) at a 5.22% weight, providing crucial ballast against falling financial holdings.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 24, 2026, to review and approve Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Bagchi was appointed as MD & CEO for a three-year term effective October 27, 2026.
Reported September 2026 gross advances of ₹33,075 billion and deposits of ₹33,275 billion.
Foreign institutional investors reduced their stake in the bank by 2.4% during the September quarter.

expected.text: Nomura projects 17% core PPOP growth for HDFC Bank in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 5.14% fund weight, HDFC Bank was the fund's worst detractor over 3 months (-0.733% contribution, -14.27% return), deepening losses across the Financials sector.

watch.text: Upcoming Q2 results release during the second week of October 2026.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T Energy CarbonLite won an LNTP order for the 2x800 MW Chandrapura thermal power plant in Jharkhand.
L&T PT&D secured multiple mega EPC orders across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and India.
The company extended the timeline for selling its stake in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad to December 31, 2026.
L&T received a ₹797 crore ammonia plant revamp order from Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers.

expected.text: Motilal Oswal projects an upside of 19% for Larsen & Toubro shares.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T is the anchor of the fund's 13.9% Industrials allocation with a 5.01% weight; its -6.15% 3-month return contributed to overall portfolio drag.

watch.text: Completion of the divestment of L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad by the December 31, 2026 deadline.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI absorbed nearly 40% of Reliance's $1.35 billion debt issuance.
The bank held virtual meetings with institutional investors and analysts on September 25, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 4.81% fund weight, SBI's -7.42% 3-month decline worsened performance across the fund's public and private banking exposure.

watch.text: Progress on SBI's plan to consolidate its primary dealership stake.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finserv Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved subscribing to up to ₹5,800 crore of warrants in Bajaj Finance via a preferential allotment.
Bajaj Finserv prepared to apply for an IRDAI reinsurance licence and recruit an ex-GIC Re chief.
Ramaswamy P. Subramaniam superannuated as President of Private Equity Investments and Group Strategy Head on September 30, 2026.

expected.text: Jefferies India sees 35% upside potential for core subsidiary Bajaj Finance.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bajaj Finserv constitutes 4.47% of the fund and was a key negative contributor (-0.423% contribution, -9.46% return), extending weakness beyond banks into lending and insurance.

watch.text: Board meeting on November 3, 2026, to approve unaudited Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results.
Formal IRDAI licence filing for the planned reinsurance venture.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: Infosys stated that the suspension of the U.S. DOL PERM program would have no material impact on its operations.
The company entered into an enterprise AI deep research partnership with Columbia University.
Infosys extended its strategic engagement with ABN AMRO to deploy AI transformations using Infosys Topaz.

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys represents 4.24% of the fund as its core IT services exposure; its 6-month drop of -20.82% and 3-month drop of -4.18% have been an ongoing performance headwind.

watch.text: Commercial execution on enterprise AI projects launched with Columbia University and ABN AMRO.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: The company received an ESG rating of 76.00 and was placed in the Leader band for FY2026.
Clarifications indicated that platform food delivery and ride apps face a uniform 5% GST rate.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 4.02% of the portfolio, Zomato generated +0.469% in 3-month contribution (+11.67% return), acting as the fund's second-best positive contributor.

watch.text: Product launch and commercial availability of the Temple wearable device.

holdings.name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd

what_changed.text: India Ratings affirmed the company's credit ratings and upgraded the outlook to Positive.
Torrent Pharma increased its investment in Torrent Urja 27 to ₹11.88 crore to secure a 26% stake in a hybrid power project.

expected.text: JPMorgan highlighted Torrent Pharma as a top pick with up to 25% upside potential.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 3.99% fund weight, Torrent Pharma is the fund's anchor Healthcare investment and maintains a 31.16% 1-year gain despite a -4.99% 3-month pullback.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 23, 2026, to review and approve Q2 and H1 FY26 financial results.

portfolio.statement: Franklin India Large Cap Fund holds 52.6% of its assets in its top 10 stocks, led by Financials (39.6%), Industrials (13.9%), and Technology (13.9%).
interp: Concentration in large-cap private and public banks makes fund returns vulnerable to interest rate cycles and foreign institutional flows.
Strong gains from Kotak Mahindra Bank and Zomato were unable to offset broad losses across HDFC Bank, M&M, and PB Fintech over the past 3 months.
portfolio.line: Large-cap banking divergence and auto declines pulled 3-month fund performance down by -5.51%.

drivers.text: Kotak Mahindra Bank delivered +0.876% in estimated 3-month contribution (+16.79% return) following CEO appointment clarity and strong provisional loan data.
HDFC Bank dropped -14.27% over 3 months, creating a -0.733% portfolio drag amid FII stake sales and rate headwinds.
Mahindra & Mahindra fell -10.65% over 3 months, detracting -0.633% from the portfolio.
Zomato added +0.469% in contribution on an 11.67% 3-month gain, leading tech performance.

Clarification of a standard 5% GST tax treatment on online delivery platforms.
